The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C has been filed by the Petitioner for grant of regular bail in FIR No.68/2021 dated 21.01.2021, registered at Police Station Punjabi Bagh for offences punishable under Sections 304B/498A/354/323/34 IPC.
2.
It is stated that the Petitioner has been in custody since 22.01.2021.
About three years and six months have passed.
It is stated that all other co- accused are on bail and that no specific allegations have been made against the Petitioner in the FIR.
It is stated that most of the witnesses have been examined and only police witnesses are left and therefore, the Petitioner can be released on bail.
